name: pmg-run-post-launch-review
description: Runs an after-action review of one launch, setting what was intended against what actually happened, with the reasons, a keep and change list and a keep, fix or remove call on the feature. Use for "run pmg-run-post-launch-review", "post-launch review", "launch retrospective", "did the feature work", "nobody is using the new feature", "keep, fix or remove", "after-action review", "review the release", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
